# ui-card



<!-- Auto Generated Below -->


## Overview

A bordered surface with optional header and footer regions. The `header` slot replaces
the `heading` prop; the `footer` region appears only when the `footer` slot is filled.

## Properties

| Property  | Attribute | Description                                                             | Type                  | Default     |
| --------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------- | ----------- |
| `heading` | `heading` | Section title, rendered as an `<h2>` unless the `header` slot is used.  | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` |
| `padding` | `padding` | `none` removes the body padding (for lists whose rows carry their own). | `"md" \| "none"`      | `'md'`      |


## Slots

| Slot       | Description      |
| ---------- | ---------------- |
|            | The default slot |
| `"footer"` |                  |
| `"header"` |                  |
